title: Fasmora 3.2610.5252 is available
message: A new version of Fasmora is available.
whatsNew: Improved browser loading feedback, with progress appearing as soon as navigation starts.
Made popup windows and redirects more reliable.
Improved page shortcut icons and Web App handling.
Refined native ad loading to reduce repeated requests.
Removed the AI-style icon from the browser’s top bar shortcut.
